visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: No dots at the end of the title
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Long names in this card are cut off with no sign that there is more text. The ellipsis is missing.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Alexandria Montgomery-Smith

solution.code: Alexandria Montgomery-Smith
solution.explanation: text-overflow only has an effect on a box that has hidden overflow, and it only adds the dots when the text is cut. Without it the text just ends at the edge.

checks.label: The text ends with an ellipsis
